privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Daylight stores everything only on this device.
privacy.stored: Stored are: entries with mood, activities, scales, notes and photos, your moods, activities, groups and scales, planned activities and your settings.
privacy.network: No accounts, no servers, no analytics, no ads. The app requests no internet permission and cannot send anything.
privacy.leave: Data only leaves the device when you share or save a backup or a CSV export yourself.
privacy.noCloudBackup: The app is excluded from the automatic Android backup. So your entries do not end up in your Google account either. The price: if you uninstall or switch devices, they are gone unless you have your own backup. After 60 days without a backup, Today reminds you.
privacy.backup: A backup is an unencrypted file with all entries, notes and photos. Keep it in a place you trust.
privacy.computed: Insights and outlook are calculated on the device from your entries. They describe your data and are not a medical statement.
privacy.reminders: The reminder is a local notification of the device. Its text reveals nothing from the journal.
privacy.lockNote: The optional app lock uses the device's unlock. While it is on, screenshots are blocked.
privacy.deleteNote: Delete all data removes entries, photos, activities, plans, health data and settings from the device and gives back access to Health Connect.
privacy.photos: You pick photos with the Android photo picker. Daylight only gets that one image, no access to your gallery and no camera. A reduced copy is kept in the app's private storage, not in the gallery.
privacy.health: When you turn on health data, Daylight reads steps, sleep, resting heart rate and exercise from Health Connect as daily values. This happens on the device, without internet. Daylight writes nothing to Health Connect. The values only go into the backup if you turn that on under Health data. You manage access in Health Connect, “Disconnect and delete data” removes everything taken over.

health.title: Health data
health.enableHint: Steps, sleep, resting heart rate and exercise, for example from Samsung Health and the Galaxy Watch. Read only.
health.disconnectBody: Daylight gives back its access to Health Connect and deletes the health data taken over from this device. Everything in Health Connect itself stays as it is.
health.denied: Without permission in Health Connect, Daylight cannot take anything over. You can grant it at any time under “Manage in Health Connect”.
health.missing: Health Connect is not installed on this device. It is built in from Android 14, before that there is the Health Connect app in the Play Store.
health.needsUpdate: Health Connect needs to be updated first.
health.unsupported: Health data is only available in the installed app on Android, not in Expo Go.
health.historyHint: For days older than 30 days, also allow access to past data in the Health Connect dialog. If that was only allowed later, “Read everything again” fetches the older days. Only what Samsung Health passed on to Health Connect is taken over.
health.readOnly: Daylight only reads and never writes anything to Health Connect. Syncing happens when the app opens, at most every 15 minutes. Health data only goes into the backup if you turn that on above. Otherwise, after a reinstall, a new sync brings back what Health Connect still has.
health.inBackupHint: The health days go into the backup too. That way sleep and steps come back after a reinstall, even when Health Connect no longer has the old days.
